description: Session-start reminder for MoEngage alerting: the ways this goes quietly wrong are an unapproved threshold or payload, a negative filter firing on success, a live flow edited in place, a save that never persisted, an intake row mistaken for an inbox, and the intake signature captured in a screenshot.

hooks.command: echo '[observability] (0) Before live work: ask which model and plan vs direct; recommend Opus for builds. Resolve the tenant; never default one. (1) Nothing is built without the owner approving the alert, threshold or wait, recipients and payload (uid, ref) in this session. (2) Filters are positive enumerations; no is-not-empty or != as the qualifying filter. (3) Confirm the header workspace and env against tenants/<name>/config.json; the email label is not the workspace. (4) Live flows cannot be edited: duplicate, rename, read back, publish, pause the original, keep the full replaced_ids chain. (5) Read back from the saved state: reopen the flow, Code view in Power Automate, the saved copy of a workbook. A toast is not success. (6) Never screenshot a connector drawer or the Power Automate trigger card; slice JS reads from Body type. (7) An intake row proves intake, not inbox. (8) Tenant facts live in tenants/<name>/, never in skills/.'
